item.title: Inside BatchBacktesting: parallel runs, explicit assumptions and useful outputs
item.description:
AlgoETS/BatchBacktesting

★ 3 · 4 forks · Repository created 2023-03-29

GitHub statistics recorded 2026-10-20.

A batch backtest is a small data pipeline: choose instruments, obtain prices, clean the observations, run a strategy, and save comparable results. AlgoETS/BatchBacktesting makes those steps visible in Python rather than hiding them behind a dashboard.

This image is an existing article illustration, not a new benchmark run.

item.title: Teaching Python through an end-to-end data workshop
item.description:
AlgoETS/Workshop1

★ 3 · 0 forks · Repository created 2023-09-07

GitHub statistics recorded 2026-10-20.

The most useful beginner workshop gives each new concept somewhere to go. AlgoETS/Workshop1 moves from Python setup to an API response, a DataFrame, and a chart. The final notebook uses Apple price data and exponential moving averages to bring those steps together.
